MathlibAnnex.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.exists_normalPart_selected_classification_eq

theorem

Classifies the given normal-part homeomorphism using its fixed factors and an operator image equality.

Statement

Let be complex Hilbert spaces, and let and be nonzero norm-closed complex -subalgebras acting irreducibly on and , respectively. Neither algebra is assumed unital. For and , define the bounded complex-linear functionals

Their normal parts are

(1)

The inner product is conjugate-linear in its first variable. For , the relative geometric closure is ; define analogously. Let be a finite-homeomorphism: a bijection satisfying for every finite . Assume is infinite-dimensional and, additionally, both and are fully continuous:

(2)

Let and be the semilinear lifts and scalar automorphisms selected in the algebraic realization of this , using the dimension bound guaranteed by infinite-dimensionality. Thus and for and . Then . There exist either two continuous complex-linear equivalences , or two continuous conjugate-linear equivalences , such that

(3)

For either common scalar type, one of the following global orientation branches holds. Write for the normal-part equivalence given by . Let be the closure-space homeomorphism induced by the involution, so that .

Direct branch. The specified equivalence is . For every and ,

(4)

Swapped branch. The specified equivalence is . For every and ,

(5)

The kernels on each side are subsets of the corresponding algebra. The forward and inverse formulas use the same branch and the same maps in (3). In either orientation, the common scalar type determines the operator-set equality

(6)

Here , and similarly for . In the second case, the conjugate adjoint is characterized by for and . For each , the corresponding product or is a bounded complex-linear operator on .

Assumptions

The two nonzero concrete -algebras are norm closed and act irreducibly on their respective Hilbert spaces. Neither algebra is assumed unital. The source space is infinite dimensional.

Both full-continuity conditions (2) are required, in addition to finite continuity in both directions. Continuity of the semilinear factors, equality of their scalar types, and the four identities (3) are conclusions.

Conclusion

The given has one common scalar type and one global direct or swapped orientation. The same maps and their inverses satisfy all point and kernel formulas. Their underlying functions are precisely those fixed by the algebraic realization of .

In either scalar case the corresponding operator-set equality (6) holds. This is equality of concrete operator sets; it does not assert that , that either map is unitary, or that the transformation is a multiplicative -isomorphism.

Main citations

The selected classification theorem gives the common scalar type, the four function identities, both orientations, all coefficient-kernel formulas and the operator image equality. The algebraic realization fixes the underlying maps. The linear and conjugate-linear operator criteria specify the two transformations.

theorem exists_normalPart_selected_classification_eq
    (hH : ¬ FiniteDimensional ℂ H)
    (hcont : ((NormedSpace.geometricStructureClosure ℂ S).subspace (normalPart S)).Continuous
      ((NormedSpace.geometricStructureClosure ℂ T).subspace (normalPart T)) e.toEquiv)
    (hcontInv : ((NormedSpace.geometricStructureClosure ℂ T).subspace (normalPart T)).Continuous
      ((NormedSpace.geometricStructureClosure ℂ S).subspace (normalPart S)) e.toEquiv.symm) :
    let hd := (three_le_rank_of_normalPart_finiteHomeomorph S T hS hT e hH).1
    let U := normalPartFirstSemilinearEquiv S T hS hT e hd
    let V := normalPartSecondSemilinearEquiv S T hS hT e hd
    normalPartFirstScalarEquiv S T hS hT e hd =
      normalPartSecondScalarEquiv S T hS hT e hd ∧
    (
    (∃ Uc Vc : H ≃L[ℂ] K,
      (∀ x, Uc x = U x) ∧ (∀ x, Vc x = V x) ∧
      (∀ z, Uc.symm z = U.symm z) ∧ (∀ z, Vc.symm z = V.symm z) ∧
      (((e.toEquiv = normalPartSemilinearEquiv S T hS hT (fun _ => rfl)
            Uc.toLinearEquiv Vc.toLinearEquiv) ∧
        (∀ (x y : H) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0),
          e.toEquiv (normalPartPoint S hS x y hx hy) =
            normalPartPoint T hT (Uc x) (Vc y)
              (by simpa only [map_zero] using Uc.injective.ne hx)
              (by simpa only [map_zero] using Vc.injective.ne hy)) ∧
        (∀ (z w : K) (hz : z ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0),
          e.toEquiv.symm (normalPartPoint T hT z w hz hw) =
            normalPartPoint S hS (Uc.symm z) (Vc.symm w)
              (by simpa only [map_zero] using Uc.symm.injective.ne hz)
              (by simpa only [map_zero] using Vc.symm.injective.ne hw)) ∧
        (∀ (x y : H) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0),
          (e.toEquiv (normalPartPoint S hS x y hx hy)).val.val =
            {b : T | inner ℂ (Vc y) ((b : K →L[ℂ] K) (Uc x)) = 0}) ∧
        (∀ (z w : K) (hz : z ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0),
          (e.toEquiv.symm (normalPartPoint T hT z w hz hw)).val.val =
            {a : S | inner ℂ (Vc.symm w) ((a : H →L[ℂ] H) (Uc.symm z)) = 0})) ∨
       ((e.toEquiv = (normalPartSemilinearEquiv S T hS hT (fun _ => rfl)
            Uc.toLinearEquiv Vc.toLinearEquiv).trans (normalPartStarHomeomorph T hT).toEquiv) ∧
        (∀ (x y : H) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0),
          e.toEquiv (normalPartPoint S hS x y hx hy) =
            normalPartPoint T hT (Vc y) (Uc x)
              (by simpa only [map_zero] using Vc.injective.ne hy)
              (by simpa only [map_zero] using Uc.injective.ne hx)) ∧
        (∀ (z w : K) (hz : z ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0),
          e.toEquiv.symm (normalPartPoint T hT z w hz hw) =
            normalPartPoint S hS (Uc.symm w) (Vc.symm z)
              (by simpa only [map_zero] using Uc.symm.injective.ne hw)
              (by simpa only [map_zero] using Vc.symm.injective.ne hz)) ∧
        (∀ (x y : H) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0),
          (e.toEquiv (normalPartPoint S hS x y hx hy)).val.val =
            {b : T | inner ℂ (Uc x) ((b : K →L[ℂ] K) (Vc y)) = 0}) ∧
        (∀ (z w : K) (hz : z ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0),
          (e.toEquiv.symm (normalPartPoint T hT z w hz hw)).val.val =
            {a : S | inner ℂ (Vc.symm z) ((a : H →L[ℂ] H) (Uc.symm w)) = 0}))) ∧
      InnerProductSpace.adjointSandwich Uc.toContinuousLinearMap Vc.toContinuousLinearMap ''
        (T : Set (K →L[ℂ] K)) = (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))) ∨
    (∃ Uc Vc : H ≃SL[starRingEnd ℂ] K,
      (∀ x, Uc x = U x) ∧ (∀ x, Vc x = V x) ∧
      (∀ z, Uc.symm z = U.symm z) ∧ (∀ z, Vc.symm z = V.symm z) ∧
      (((e.toEquiv = normalPartSemilinearEquiv S T hS hT (fun _ => rfl)
            Uc.toLinearEquiv Vc.toLinearEquiv) ∧
        (∀ (x y : H) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0),
          e.toEquiv (normalPartPoint S hS x y hx hy) =
            normalPartPoint T hT (Uc x) (Vc y)
              (by simpa only [map_zero] using Uc.injective.ne hx)
              (by simpa only [map_zero] using Vc.injective.ne hy)) ∧
        (∀ (z w : K) (hz : z ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0),
          e.toEquiv.symm (normalPartPoint T hT z w hz hw) =
            normalPartPoint S hS (Uc.symm z) (Vc.symm w)
              (by simpa only [map_zero] using Uc.symm.injective.ne hz)
              (by simpa only [map_zero] using Vc.symm.injective.ne hw)) ∧
        (∀ (x y : H) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0),
          (e.toEquiv (normalPartPoint S hS x y hx hy)).val.val =
            {b : T | inner ℂ (Vc y) ((b : K →L[ℂ] K) (Uc x)) = 0}) ∧
        (∀ (z w : K) (hz : z ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0),
          (e.toEquiv.symm (normalPartPoint T hT z w hz hw)).val.val =
            {a : S | inner ℂ (Vc.symm w) ((a : H →L[ℂ] H) (Uc.symm z)) = 0})) ∨
       ((e.toEquiv = (normalPartSemilinearEquiv S T hS hT (fun _ => rfl)
            Uc.toLinearEquiv Vc.toLinearEquiv).trans (normalPartStarHomeomorph T hT).toEquiv) ∧
        (∀ (x y : H) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0),
          e.toEquiv (normalPartPoint S hS x y hx hy) =
            normalPartPoint T hT (Vc y) (Uc x)
              (by simpa only [map_zero] using Vc.injective.ne hy)
              (by simpa only [map_zero] using Uc.injective.ne hx)) ∧
        (∀ (z w : K) (hz : z ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0),
          e.toEquiv.symm (normalPartPoint T hT z w hz hw) =
            normalPartPoint S hS (Uc.symm w) (Vc.symm z)
              (by simpa only [map_zero] using Uc.symm.injective.ne hw)
              (by simpa only [map_zero] using Vc.symm.injective.ne hz)) ∧
        (∀ (x y : H) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0),
          (e.toEquiv (normalPartPoint S hS x y hx hy)).val.val =
            {b : T | inner ℂ (Uc x) ((b : K →L[ℂ] K) (Vc y)) = 0}) ∧
        (∀ (z w : K) (hz : z ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0),
          (e.toEquiv.symm (normalPartPoint T hT z w hz hw)).val.val =
            {a : S | inner ℂ (Vc.symm z) ((a : H →L[ℂ] H) (Uc.symm w)) = 0}))) ∧
      InnerProductSpace.conjugateAdjointSandwich Uc.toContinuousLinearMap Vc.toContinuousLinearMap ''
        (T : Set (K →L[ℂ] K)) = (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))))
